text:
marta: Quick sync — need final signoff on the rollout/playbook for the tiered cutover we're calling 'signal-playbook'. Customers (FinApp & RetailCo) asked for per-region gradual ramp + hard fallback to model-v1 when latency spikes. Draft below, please ack or call out blockers.

kevin: skimmed — nice. main asks: 1) feature flag name? 2) canary windows + percentages? 3) automated rollback thresholds?

sam: feature flag: `ff.signal_playbook.v1` (namespaced with product). Canary: 0.5% -> 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 4 windows. Each window 30m bake + 15m observation.

rebecca: +1 on windows but suggest region staging order: US-East -> US-West -> EU -> APAC (APAC only after overall 75% stable due to infra constraints). Also require per-region latency spike threshold: 99p latency > 500ms for 10m triggers fallback.

felix: clarify fallback behavior: ops-bot should trigger automatic downgrade to model-v1 for the affected region and send a Slack alert to #eng-oncall + create a ticket with tags. Also allow manual override to keep newer model for key customers (opt-in via tenant flag).

marta: yes, opt-in for priority tenants (flag: `tenant.<id>.signal_opt_in`) — legal/privacy is OK per Rebecca. Add rollout gating: no rollout if error rate increase > 0.5% absolute over baseline or token cost > +30% over baseline for 15m.

kevin: we should also capture QA acceptance and launch criteria: 1) perf tests on staging showing median latency within 10% of model-v1, 2) end-to-end correctness sample (100 prompts) pass rate >= 95% on humans + automated checks, 3) cost model validated by infra.

sam: noted. I'll wire the canary automation with these thresholds. Pseudocode for automation:
```
if (region.error_rate_delta > 0.005 || region.latency_99 > 500 || region.cost_delta > 0.3) {
  ops-bot.triggerFallback(region, 'model-v1');
  notify('#eng-oncall', 'fallback triggered for '+region);
}
```

rebecca: ops question — how do we handle partial KV cache warmup? fallback to v1 may cause correctness regressions if caches aren't primed. Suggest a shadow-traffic warmup step: 10% traffic mirrored to model-v2 for 2h pre-cutover per region to populate cache.

felix: good call. Add warmup to preflight: mirror mode for 2h, then canary windows. Also add TTL-based KV invalidation plan in case mismatch happens.

marta: timeline ask: PM wants launch next Tuesday. Can we realistically do mirror + 4x windows + dataset QA by then? If not, propose a soft launch for internal customers only.

kevin: tight. Mirror 2h + full canary likely pushes to Wed. If we do internal-only Tuesday (restricted tenant list + no APAC) we can meet Tuesday. Recommend internal soft-launch, then global Wed/Thu.

rebecca: ops-bot will run scheduled checks. I've added a checklist to the playbook: preflight mirror, canary windows, telemetry dashboards live, rollback runbook tested.

marta: action items: sam will implement automation + flags today, kevin to update playbook doc with gating criteria, rebecca to confirm ops-bot alert flows & runbook, felix to add tenant opt-in plumbing. I'll coordinate comms with sales for FinApp & RetailCo. Please react :thumbsup: when done.

ops-bot: [automated] scheduled job created: `signal-playbook-canary-watch` (runs every 1m). Alerts wired to #eng-oncall and PagerDuty.

kevin: leaving this thread open for signoffs. tagging cross-functional reviewers: @sam @rebecca @felix @marta

sam: done — automation PR opened: https://git.internal/r/signal-playbook/pr/42

rebecca: done — runbook updated and smoke tests scheduled at 09:00 UTC tomorrow.

felix: tenant opt-in hooks ready in staging, need prod feature flag rollout.

marta: thanks all. I'll send calendar invite for go/no-go at 08:30 UTC next Tuesday.
